name: Vesper Velvetcap
title: The starter
description: A steady hand for a first run: a fast home colony, and a burst of spores to break a push.

passive.text: Buildings in your home columns spawn 10% faster.

power.name: Spore Burst
power.text: 90 crush damage to every enemy unit and building within 2 tiles of a point.

name: Armilla the Vast
title: The landholder
description: Slow, heavy and greedy for ground: she takes columns faster, and her roots draw gold from every one she holds.

power.name: Rhizome Tithe
power.text: Your roots draw on your ground: +30 gold for every column you hold past your home columns.

name: Cordis the Puppeteer
title: The merger
description: Knits small units into big ones: merges finish in half the time, and a bloom merges a crowd mid-fight.

passive.text: Merges knit in half the time, and units merge from 2 tiles apart.

power.name: Puppet Bloom
power.text: Every trio of the same unit within 3 tiles of a point merges at once, even in combat.
